description: Line absorbers' k-distributions per 1 nm cell reduced from the ExoMol line list WCCRMT for 14N2, the triplet system, as its archive holds it (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.f; decision-r08-t4ef-storage; decision-r08-t4e-budget; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md sections 9-11), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs exomol-k-distributions-merge from the fetched files named here, which are not committed. Adapted material of the ExoMol database, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE). The cells are in the binary parts listed, little-endian: HYKD, u16 version, cells, variants, temperatures, pressures and 0; then per cell u16 nm, u16 G, f64 ln sigma (m2 a molecule) of code 1, f64 its step, G f64 weights, and u16 codes over variants x temperaturesK x pressuresPa x g, g fastest, code 0 for sigma 0, else ln sigma = offset + step (code - 1). pressuresPa are air-equivalent broadening pressures; a two-variant table's values are mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. A cell of G = 1 is stored as its mean (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 9).
source: ExoMol line list WCCRMT for 14N2, the triplet system, as its archive holds it (C. M. Western, L. Carter-Blatchford, P. Crozet, A. J. Ross, J. Morville and D. W. Tokaryk, The spectrum of N2 from 4,500 to 15,700 cm-1 revisited with PGOPHER, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf. 219 (2018) 127-141, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2018.07.017; its partition function P. S. Barklem and R. Collet, Astron. Astrophys. 588 (2016) A96); J. Tennyson et al., The 2024 release of the ExoMol database: molecular line lists for exoplanet and other hot atmospheres, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf. 326 (2024) 109083, DOI 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2024.109083
fetched: 2026-10-29, from the database's archive on Zenodo (ExoMol's own site was not reachable from the reducing machine)
terms: CC BY-SA 4.0, the ExoMol database's licence ('All data in ExoMol is released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0) licence', https://www.exomol.com/data/licence/, as read 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-13); the files fetched from the database's archive of each dataset on Zenodo, whose records state CC BY 4.0 (read 2026-10-29); the values here are reduced from them, adapted material offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README.md beside this directory, and NOTICE); the line lists' files are not committed (decision-r08-licences.md)
reduction: N2's triplet system in the range, the first positive (B3Pig-A3Sigmau+) bands from the metastable A state among them (WCCRMT, R08.T4.f), from 1800 K. Each 1 nm vacuum cell's absorption at each node from super-lines: every line's S(T) (ExoMol's intensity formula, Q(T) from the list's .pf, times the isotopologue's natural abundance) binned linearly on a wavenumber grid of a twelfth of the Doppler half-width at 13100 cm-1 (the heaviest isotopologue's where a table takes several), finer than a tenth of the narrowest Voigt half-width; at each node the bins over the cell and 25 cm-1 each side, coarsened by a whole factor while the step stays under a tenth of the node's narrowest Voigt half-width and a 600th of the cut-off (0.042 cm-1), their binning's response divided out, and convolved by FFT with Voigt profiles (Humlicek 1982) cut off 25 cm-1 from each bin at every pressure, at the Doppler widths of the cell's two edges blended linearly in wavenumber; sampled at the cell's points as R08.T4.d's lines are. Every line takes the list's default air width (cm-1 per bar at 296 K, ExoMol's unit), estimated, so that every node's line shape is estimated; sorted into its k-distribution and reduced to two-point Gauss-Legendre g-intervals shared by every node of the cell, by bisection to 8e-4 in T over every column; temperature nodes on E1' (decision-r08-t4e-budget section 1.4: 50 K steps to 1000 K, then each step the largest multiple of 50 K within 10% of its lower node) from the species' floor (decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 1.4, E2), refined by bisection to a quarter of E1's step where the chain test (cubic in T on ln sigma, the client's rows at the standard pressures each read between the table's nodes, the read cubic in ln p on tau) fails 2e-3 within its columns (the gated column, and the species' own Rayleigh column, R08.T4.g's ruling); alternate pressure nodes below 1 MPa dropped where it passes (E3), and an 8-a-decade midpoint added between two held rows below 1 MPa where it fails by the read itself (decision-r08-t4e-unsold's follow-up); ln sigma stored in 16 bits a value (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md). Stated none below 1800 K (transparency.ts's N2 entry, whose limit the table's first node meets: the belowK contract's table branch); above 4000 K the 4000 K node is held, estimated. In LTE: a non-LTE A-state population (an aurora's) is not modelled. The table is estimated, as the plan's band model was: WCCRMT's PGOPHER model is fitted to spectra over 4500-15700 cm-1 and carried past it, its widths assumed. Its .def gives no default width, so every line takes 0.07 cm-1 per bar with n = 0.5, the default all the other R08.T4.f lists' .def give but Harris's (0.084), estimated; its Q(T) is its .pf, interpolated from Barklem and Collet 2016's, its states file holding the triplet states alone. Its cells lie 20-30 times under the band model's pending bound, which put each band's strength in its origin's cell from short lifetimes.
